notes: Enriched leads with the score and recommendation a person would accept. Rule cases never reach the model. Synthetic data: no real owners or properties.

cases.title: A do-not-call contact is disqualified before any model call
Do-not-call wins over tax delinquency and an expired listing
No street address: nothing to contact or value
No ZIP: the address is not usable
Vacant land is outside single-family and small multifamily
Any source calling the property commercial disqualifies it
Owner-occupied with no distress is held, not scored by a model
An active listing is not a distress signal for an owner-occupant
Absentee owner, listing expired after 199 days, 22 years of ownership
